as melanocytes.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
A melanoma tumour is cancerous and may spread to other parts of the body.
T-vec is a new drug that has been developed to treat melanoma that has spread to other
parts of the body, including lymph nodes.
T-vec contains a virus that infects some of the melanoma cells, causing the cells to burst
and release their contents. Some of the contents of the melanoma cells act as cytokines and
others act as antigens.
Explain the effects of the cytokines and antigens released from melanoma cells in stimulating
the immune system to destroy the cancerous cells.
